mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Economy-agnostic form law (§CROSS row 3): Werewolf is permanent dominant form; kit maps the in-form loop. Fury is physical — THE PHYSICAL RULE: no element_primary. §A row 5: Feral Rage stack-ramp = sustain-stack (NOT accumulator; the stack IS the steady-state, no counted-tier release). No ailment attestation in fetched dossier. Metamorphosis unique helm (RotW/S13-14 post-cutoff item) = item-layer texture; flagged as post-cutoff. Fireclaws Wolf is a distinct kit (d2-fireclaw-wolf), not a variant here.
